messages.text: If you find the kitchen light on, I was up around 3:15 doing the long-term-care math again, then chasing headlines. Didn’t want to wake you.
I saw your walking shoes missing. Salish Ponds?
Yes. Two laps before breakfast. It took the sharp edges off.
Coffee first, then ten minutes. You are not carrying anything alone.
Dad, if that MyChart PDF won't print, forward it to me. I can clean it up after lunch.
Thanks. It's the September 18 note from Mt. Hood Digestive Health. I want it in the blue folder before I lose it.
Got it. Is that the one with the “come back in three years” line?
That's the one. Two little spots taken care of, and no extra visit unless Holcomb says otherwise.
Dad, quick check for Saturday: could you and Mom aim for after 2? I get off the 7p-7a at St. Charles that morning and need a nap before Eliza’s rehearsal.
That works. We can leave Fairview after breakfast and not rush the pass.
Perfect. Tom has Ben at soccer at 10, then Eliza at dance at 1.
😂 He says five is basically grown. Good luck with that.

Kiddo, when you're off shift, can I ask a nurse-daughter question? MyChart has that lab graph from Friday with three dots in a row headed the wrong way, and Holcomb's nurse tagged it for my March 12 visit.
No stewing. It was 5.8 last summer, 6.1 in November, 6.4 now. The note just says to discuss it at the visit.
Okay. Bring the printout and a few days of honest breakfast/snack notes. Let Holcomb walk you through it. Also maybe not two slices of pie before bed this week, Dad. ❤️
Liam is asking if Friday can include dinner at your place. He specifically mentioned the fish with the crispy edges.
Tell him yes. I will get salmon at Fred Meyer and do it in the cast iron with lemon and the little potatoes.
She does, and I am not promising any leftovers.
Honey, I saw the shop door pulled almost closed and the bench lamp was not on. I put the kettle on and left your blue mug on the freezer.
Thank you. Just needed the quiet out here for a bit.
Take your time, sweetheart. Soup is on low when you come in.
Sweetheart, did the little white Fred Meyer bag make it into your jacket pocket yesterday?
Yes. Lisinopril 10 mg is in the kitchen drawer, not the truck this time.
Good. Dr. Holcomb's portal note also asked for a week of morning and evening cuff numbers before the 13th.
I put the notebook by the coffee tin so I cannot pretend I forgot.
mr. b, still good for sat at 2? i can bring the little block plane this time 🔨
Yes. Bring that, and the maple offcut from your Gresham job if you still have it.
Nearly two years of you trying to rush a chisel. We will celebrate by making you slow down.
Sweetheart, if you are stopping at Fred Meyer, the Full Sail amber and the brown ale are both marked down on the end cap.
Good timing. I will get one six-pack, not both.
No danger. Brown ale with the chili tonight, and the rest can last the week.
columbia still up. troutdale gauge looks better than wed
I saw that. If the wind stays down, I’ll pick you up at 6:10.
Sandwiches too. Same bank below the power lines?
yep. hal would say quit fussing and cast
mr b want me to grab those maple bars from sandy bakery before shop? 🔨
Bring coffee only, please. I'm writing down the week's breakfasts and snacks for Holcomb, and I don't need a maple bar in ink.
Exactly. The man already has a red arrow on a lab chart to wave at me.
still good for 2 today Mr. B? i can do the long rip cuts if your right hand is being cranky again 🔨
Come at 2. I am all right today, but I will let you run the first boards through. No sense pretending I am 45.
Nearly two months of pointing instead of cutting. You got a lot of practice whether you wanted it or not.
Bossing is a craft skill too.
Dr. Holcomb's portal note came through. "Just above where I'd like it; continue current plan." That sounds like no change?
That's how I'd read it, yes. Keep the 10 mg with your evening routine unless his office calls.
Good. Susan already has salmon on the list twice this week.
Fairview Diner has the apple crumble on the board again.
Then I know where we are going after service.
I will share. I ignored the bakery case all week for this.
Are you and Mom around next weekend? Liam wanted to bring over the bridge he built.
We’ll be at Rachel’s. Leaving Friday after lunch and coming home Sunday afternoon.
That works. Tell Liam I want to see whether the bridge holds a coffee mug this time.
How was Grandma Marjorie today? Cedar Grove called me back about the evening tablet — just watch for extra sleepiness after lunch.
She was tired when I got there, but Eliza’s recital clip got a smile. She asked twice if it was Sunday.
Yes. 1:30 to almost 4. Gresham traffic was kind to me for once.
Random finance question at lunch: do you and Mom just wait for the county tax bill, or set money aside monthly?
Monthly. We treat it like a bill we haven't received yet.
$575 goes to the county-tax tab each month. Another $250 goes to December gifts, meals, and extra driving. The regular savings stays at 8 months of household expenses.
Are you free tomorrow morning to talk through that threshold seal? Five minutes, probably.
After 9 would be better. Walt starts us at 7:30 sharp over at the community center, and he gives me grief if my phone buzzes in my pocket.
Perfect.
Dad, Mom said your Holcomb visit is tomorrow. Bring the cuff with you if it is the same old one from the hall closet.
Already in the canvas bag with the notebook. Seven days of numbers, mostly tidy handwriting.
No. 10 mg with breakfast every morning. Your mother has the eagle eye.
Excellent. Text me after if he changes anything. Love you ❤️
Honey, I put the two pharmacy slips by your coffee. Mine was $18. Yours was $31.
Saw them. With the two monthly drafts, we’re right at $397 for March.
Good. Leave the PERS envelope out too, please. I want the dates matching before I close the folder.
I added a page for your July local event: parking, who signs your hours, tool list, and two questions for the coordinator.
mr b july is like 4 months away 😂
True. I sleep better when the loose ends are on paper instead of running laps in my head.
Mom said the Fred Meyer app keeps making you log in. Want me to look Saturday?
Please. It shows the little 10 mg one due again in June, but I can't find the 90-day setting.
Sure. Also Liam votes for Grandpa pancakes, not oat pancakes.
sandy next sat?
Works for me. Holcomb’s office finally handed me the little reminder card, so nothing else medical until September.
They might care about my knees by then.
Mom said last night was heavy. She said she found you out back after the call. You okay this morning? ❤️
I’m all right. I was in the shop awhile, no lamps, just the old chair by the scrap bin.
She did. She just sat by the door until I was ready to come in.
river looks decent. you tying leaders or am i
You tie them. My fingers are slow before breakfast, and my back is arguing with the cold garage.
That and thinking I could carry oak doors alone in 1986.
I will bring sandwiches. Give me the small net today; easier on the hands.
Honey, I found the after-visit sheet from September tucked in with the Fred Meyer receipts. Do you want it shredded?
Keep it, please. That sheet has the three-year date on it.
Yes. And the lab page with the two bits they removed. Holcomb may ask for it.
Liam wants to bring one old work paper for family history day. Do you have one of your estimate sheets with the little plane-and-board drawing on top?
I do. There is a blank pad in the drawer by the miter saw, and a paid invoice from the first year in the 1990 file.
Mostly me. I measured the room, drew the elevations, priced the lumber, built the cabinets or shelves, and installed them. I brought in Ray or another pair of hands only for the heavy runs.
Add the occasional table or chair, but yes, kitchens and built-ins kept the lights on until I closed the last job file in 2022.
Coffee is ready, sweetheart.
Coming in. Buster found a puddle.
Of course he did.
rain finally quit here
Same. Yard smells like wet fir.
left the clamp in your shop?
Yes. Under the bench by the red can.
thx Mr B 👍
Please grab bananas if you pass produce.
Bananas, milk, and no mystery cookies.
A responsible list.
Liam says your pencil sharpener is superior.
Tell him excellence has a crank handle.
Ben wants to know if Buster snores.
Like a small tractor.
He is delighted.
Book club moved to Carol’s.
I’ll keep the driveway clear.
Frost on your end?
Light frost. Buster disapproves.
Soup is in the blue pot.
Thank you. I’ll wash up first.
Can you send the shelf bracket photo?
Sent. Ignore the crooked tape measure.
windy there?
Enough to move the empty bins.
trash day ballet
you want your sawhorse back?
Keep it until Saturday. Bring the clamp too.
I left towels by the back door.
Buster and I both needed them.
Bridge survived the coffee mug.
Tell Liam the engineer approves.
traffic on Division is dumb today
Take Halsey if you can.
good call 👍
Eliza says happy birthday again ❤️
Tell her the card is on the mantel.
I put your gray sweater by the chair.
Thank you. The house feels Marchy.
